import { ExtractInput, ExtractInputKind, ExtractionConfig, extractBatch } from "@xberg-io/xberg";

  const config: ExtractionConfig = { securityLimits: { maxContentSize: 1 } };
  try {
    await extractBatch([{ bytes: await (await import("node:fs/promises")).readFile("text/fake_text.txt"), kind: ExtractInputKind.Bytes, mimeType: "text/plain" } as ExtractInput], config);
